title: Studio: the object designer's field panel cannot turn on a lookup's referenceNameVisible
body:
domain:ui#3 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jV4dWohojjbTJTQq5m

Filing gate: ② out-of-scope finding, class b (a declared key that a Studio author cannot set), from #29462 (claim amendment 6590220295). Filed by `domain:ui#3`. ⛔ Not a claim. No grade: triage sets it.

**Business reason.** #29171 ruling B added `referenceNameVisible` to `lookup` and `user` fields. When a reader cannot open the target record, they see its name as plain text instead of a "restricted record" placeholder. #29460 (PR #29576) serves the name, and #29462 renders it and adds the row to the generic `field` metadata form (`packages/spec/src/data/field.form.ts`). But an admin who builds an object in Studio edits fields in the object designer, and the designer's field panel cannot turn the key on. So the feature can only be reached through the generic metadata form or code.

**Observed.** The #29462 os-dev probed it live as admin: `/apps/setup/metadata/object/rnv_expense` with a lookup field selected. The panel is the hand-written `ObjectFieldInspector` (`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/inspectors/ObjectFieldInspector.tsx`), and it has no such control. Screenshot: `/mnt/project-files/issue-29462/shots/studio-designer.png`.

**Wanted.** A `referenceNameVisible` toggle in `ObjectFieldInspector`'s lookup section, shown for `lookup` and `user` only. It should sit next to the existing lookup picker config (`displayField` / filters, ~L2242). Its label and help text should match the `field.form.ts` row's wording, and it should be saved through the inspector's existing `patchDef`. Other field types are unchanged.

**Tests.**
- The inspector on a `lookup` and a `user` field shows the toggle, and saving writes `referenceNameVisible: true`.
- A CONTROL text field shows no toggle.
- The ablation goes red.
- The PR includes a live screenshot.

**Landing site:** `ui/packages/app-shell` (`ObjectFieldInspector.tsx`), plus `@object-ui/i18n` keys if the inspector localises its labels. Serialize after #29462, which lands the row wording.

Dedupe: `is:issue ObjectFieldInspector referenceNameVisible` (only #29462), and `is:issue is:open ObjectFieldInspector` (QA runs only).

Links back: #29462, #29460, PR #29576, #29171.
